g.text: 1. D01: the seven Ø2.2 pad holes are merged into one slot (webs would be 0.34 mm).
2. D02: a blind seat is impossible (ball top at z 0.9 in a 1.0 mm plate). The printed cone is a
pilot only: finish each seat with a 90° spot drill to depth, or set the balls on a gauge
plate (0.1 proud) and pot them. The pin-hole is closed by the PCB adhesive sheet.
3. D03: baffle ring enlarged for the photodiode diagonal; spokes unequally spaced.
4. The top face is the PCB bonding face and the seal land (r 21.35 to 21.75): keep flat,
no vapor-smoothing sink marks. Thin-skin regions at the seats: check 5 (D02).
5. Hidden lines (dashed) show the cone mouths on the underside.
